description: No scene JSON or views manifest was provided in the user message. Unable to analyze object group 'Cubes' or 'CoffeeMachine2' without the Unity scene data.

diagnostics.message: Missing input: the Unity scene JSON (SCENE_JSON) and optional VIEWS_MANIFEST_JSON were not included in the request. Provide the exported Unity scene JSON that contains object entries (paths, names, roles, interactionParams, unityTag, isPartOfDevice, transform, materials, worldAabb/bounding boxes, stableId, parent/children) so the scene can be analyzed.

When you provide the scene JSON, the analysis will: (1) list all interaction element names (exact Unity names) and visualization element names under the 'Cubes' group representing 'CoffeeMachine2'; (2) produce ObjectEntry items with roles, interactionParams, unityTag, isPartOfDevice, transform, materials, bounding boxes, and confidence scores; (3) add relations for explicit/strongly implied functional links; (4) propose clusters (device body, control panel, screen assembly); and (5) provide suggestions for which Unity objects should go into InteractionElements.json and VisualizationElements.json.

If you have images, include them (or a views manifest) to allow visual confirmation of roles/relationships. Note: measurements will not be guessed; only fields present in the scene JSON will be used for sizes/positions.
Do not rename or add Unity object names. The analysis requires exact, case-sensitive Unity names/paths to produce the requested InteractionElements.json and VisualizationElements.json suggestions.
